GameConditionDef.label: zombie silence
GameConditionDef.description: Zombies vanish from the world for a short time. Ordinary zombies die out and new zombies do not appear while this condition lasts.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The zombie silence has ended. Zombies can appear again.
GameConditionDef.letterText: For a short time, zombies are dying out across the world and no new zombies will appear. This is a good window for travel.
